description: The WSL2 DNS proxy as seen on lo: 20 lookups where 10.255.255.254 sends queries and answers to itself, plus one TCP SYN from 10.255.255.254:53 to itself. Every frame is a loopback frame (all-zero MACs), so neither land rule fires (eth_dst:!zero). land_attack still fires on the same packets with real MACs.
